stem: A hose repeatedly crosses a main aisle during every irrigation event. Which control is strongest?
choices: Post a reminder sign and leave the hose in place
Reroute or secure the hose so it no longer creates the repeated trip hazard
Tell experienced workers they can ignore it
Require workers to walk faster through the aisle
rationale: Changing the work setup to remove or reduce the repeated hazard is stronger than relying only on attention or warnings.
